tasks.short: Help implement electromechanical designs and separately record and communicate the implementation results.

steps.what: Retrieve current electromechanical designs, implementation instructions and component references
Clarify implementation tasks, interfaces and site constraints with the engineers
Assist engineers to implement the electromechanical designs at the actual installation
Check the implemented work against the design and engineer's instructions
Record completed implementation work, checks and unresolved design issues
Send the checked implementation status and unresolved issues to the engineer

tasks.design: Configure current implementation references in {DOCS} and an implementation record layout in {PROJECT}. Retain engineer discussion, practical work and checks, then separately record the outcome and send its checked status through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementation references and completed-work details require repeated lookup and recording.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and project fields can reduce that supporting effort.
tasks.still_hard: Actual interfaces, site constraints and unexpected equipment behaviour require practical engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a mismatch and resolve it with the engineer rather than improvise an unsupported design change.
tasks.altitude: Give more attention to implementation quality and unresolved interfaces.

reach.learn: Use the actual work record and check findings.

evidence.claim: Native reference views and implementation record fields could shorten supporting lookup and writing; physical implementation remains human work.

assumptions: This task includes the existing completed-work record and engineer status handoff. Both are separately priced from practical implementation.

The technician produces work identity, design revision, completed action, check result and unresolved issue fields in s5, retaining seven hours. Missing or disputed details require manual clarification before the status is sent.
Native views and fields come first. No software changes controls, actuates equipment, performs a test or releases an installation in this design.
The actual internal status send checks the final content and engineer recipient. An ordinary author save has no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Current reference versioning and implementation record requirements.
research_questions: Can native records reduce writing when implementation deviates from the original design?

already_counted.description: Capture completed work and check findings in the implementation record.

incremental.description: Maintain reference links and implementation fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final implementation status, check findings, unresolved issues and engineer recipient; edits or recipient changes require a fresh send-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=95, gross=5; upkeep=1 gives net=4. Conservative case: conflicting reference versions leave lookup at ten hours and unusual work retains nine of ten record hours; R=99, net=0. Compatible reference links and ordinary records retain nine lookup and eight record hours, R=97, net=2. Engineer discussion, implementation, checks and the real send retain 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult machinists about design conformance and separately record and communicate the technical conclusions.

steps.what: Retrieve electromechanical design specifications, drawings and relevant machining records
Examine the equipment features and identify questions about design conformance
Consult with machinists and resolve whether equipment features meet design specifications
Write the consultation conclusions, evidence and unresolved design specification questions
Send the final consultation record to the relevant machinist and engineer

tasks.design: Configure linked design references and a technical consultation template in {DOCS}. Keep equipment examination and the machinist discussion, separately write its conclusions and send the checked final record through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications and discussion conclusions must be repeatedly located and written up.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document views and conformance record headings can support those actions.
tasks.still_hard: The meaning of a specification and actual manufacturing constraints require technical dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve differing interpretations without treating an unresolved issue as conformance.
tasks.altitude: Make consultation outcomes traceable while retaining the technical conversation.

reach.learn: Connect each conclusion to the relevant feature and specification revision.

evidence.claim: Native specification views and consultation templates could shorten lookup and writing without replacing technical dialogue or conformance judgement.

assumptions: Machinists are colleagues in this scenario, so the consultation and record send have internal authority. This is not an external customer handoff.

The technician produces feature identity, drawing revision, question, evidence, conclusion and unresolved point in s4, retaining 15 hours. Unresolved interpretations remain explicit and require further human discussion.
The record and actual send are separately priced from the conversation. Native headings and reference links come first, with no model or hidden machine write.
Only the actual send checks its exact final version and recipients. Ordinary author edits and same-system saves have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Specification revision quality and current consultation record practice.
research_questions: Does a native record template reduce writing when machinist interpretations remain disputed?

already_counted.description: Write technical consultation conclusions and unresolved questions.

incremental.description: Maintain specification links and consultation headings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final consultation record, referenced specification revisions and machinist and engineer recipients; edits require a fresh send-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=92, gross=8; upkeep=2 gives net=6. Conservative case: bespoke or disputed conclusions retain all 20 writing hours, while linked references save two lookup hours; R=98, net=0. Compatible revision links and usable headings retain 13 lookup and 17 writing hours, R=95, net=3. Equipment examination, consultation and actual sending retain 65 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep practical implementation and technical consultation human while improving their complete supporting records.
reach: Connect actual equipment work and machinist knowledge with traceable engineering decisions.
role.ambitious_version: A mechatronics technician who supports engineers with careful practical work and clear, source-linked implementation and consultation records.

job.title: Electro-Mechanical and Mechatronics Technologists and Technicians
